waterLeak.text: It rains and irradiated water leaks into your shelter. You are cold and sick.

highWind.text: High winds blow away parts of your shelter.

rodentInfestation.text: You wake up to find rats chewing your supplies.

moldOutbreak.text: The shelter walls grow slimy with mold.

roofCollapse.text: A section of the ceiling collapses in the night.

gasLeak.text: A chemical smell fills the bunker. You feel dizzy.

bugBiteInfection.text: Something bit you. It's swelling fast.

wokenByStorm.text: Thunder shakes your shelter. You barely sleep.

sleepwalkingAccident.text: You wake up with a bruised leg and no memory.

calmNight.text: Nothing happens. For once, you rest well.

mutantRaid.text: Something claws at the bunker door. You brace it shut.

scavengerBreakIn.text: A figure breaks in and grabs supplies before fleeing.

wildDogAttack.text: A pack of wild dogs gnaws at the shelter entrance.

intruderWarning.text: Footsteps pass near your shelter. You hold your breath.

suppliesPoisoned.text: A raider slipped something into your food.

noiseDistraction.text: A loud bang outside keeps you awake.

camperDispute.text: Someone demands more food. Tension rises.

airFilterFailure.text: Your filter malfunctions. You cough through the night.

tickleMonster.text: You are visited by the ticklemonster. He is harmless.

radioStatic.text: Faint radio static echoes. You can’t sleep.

strangeDreams.text: You dream of green fields and blue skies.

meteorShower.text: You watch streaks of fire paint the sky.

coldSnap.text: The temperature drops suddenly. You shiver all night.

cometGlimpse.text: You glimpse a comet. You feel lucky.

nightWhispers.text: You hear whispers in the dark. You're unsure if they're real.

oldMemories.text: You find a photo from before. It breaks you.

hopefulBirdsong.text: You hear birds. Maybe life will return.

eerieSilence.text: Not a sound all night. It's unnerving.

giftFromStranger.text: You wake to find a medkit and some food outside.

travelersDiary.text: You find a hidden journal. It changes your outlook.

fungusBloom.text: Bioluminescent fungus grows on the wall. You harvest it.

ancientTechCache.text: You find a sealed crate of pre-war tech.
